3. Definitions

  • Personal data: any information related to the natural person identified or identifiable (LGPD, Art. 5, I).
  • Sensitive data: personal data on racial origin, religious conviction, opinion policy, health, sexual life, genetic or biometric data (LGPD, art. 5, II). We don't handle data. Sensitive on this site.
  • Holder: the natural person to whom the personal data refer.
  • Treatment: any operation performed with personal data (collection, use, access, storage, disposal etc.).
  • Controller: who are responsible for decisions on treatment.
  • Operator: who handles data on behalf of the controller (e.g. AWS, Google).
  • Anonymisation: process that makes the data non-associable to the determined individual.
  • Charged (DPO): person indicated to act as a channel between holders, controllers and ANPD.

7. International data transfer

Our main operators (AWS, Google, Meta, GitHub) process data on servers located in United States and in other countries. Transfers take place on the basis of guarantees provided for in art. LGPD 33 and Resolution CD/ANPD 19/2024:

  • Contractual standard clauses (SCCs) signed with each operator.
  • EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework for certified operators.
  • Specific contractual guarantees equivalent to the LGPD level of protection.

  • Access to your data

  • Anonymisation, blocking or elimination Unneeded or processed data on non-compliance
  • Portability to another supplier
  • Elimination data processed with your consent
  • Information about who we share your data with
  • Information on the possibility of not consenting and its consequences
  • Repeal consent
  • Opposition treatment based on legitimate interest
  • Human Review automated decisions affecting your interests

10. Cookies and similar technologies

We use cookies in four categories:

  • Strictly necessary: essential to navigation and safety. Always active.
  • Analysis: Aggregated metrics via Google Analytics 4. Opt-in.
  • Marketing: remarketing via Meta Pixel and Google Ads. Opt-in.
  • Customization: a reminder of preferences. Opt-in.

The consent banner appears on your first visit, according to the Cookie Guide from ANPD. You can review your choices at any time by clicking on the icon in the corner bottom of the screen. The full nominal list is in cookies. html.

Important We don't use cookie wall (we do not block the content of those who refuse non-essential cookies) in compliance with the understanding of ANPD and EDPB.

11. Artificial intelligence and automated decisions

Some public demonstrations (e.g.: Knowledge OS) may include conversational interfaces based on language models (LLMs). In accordance with EU AI Act (EU Regulation) 2024/1689) and the positioning of the DPRK on generative AI:

  • Content generated by AI is identified as such to the user.
  • We don't train. AI models with your personal data without explicit consent and specific.
  • Decisions with relevant effect (e.g. approval of a lead) go through review human before any communication to the holder (LGPD, art. 20).
  • You can request a human review of any automated decision via DPO.

12. Information security

We adopt technical and administrative measures proportional to risk (LGPD art. 46-49; Decree 8.771/2016):

Technical measures

  • Encrypted connection with TLS 1.3
  • Encryption at-rest in storage buckets
  • Principle of lower privilege (IAM, MFA)
  • Federated authentication (OIDC) for IC/CD — no hardcoded credentials
  • Safety Heads (HSTS, CSP, X-Frame-Options)

Organisational measures

  • Internal data protection policy
  • NDA with providers
  • Training and periodic review

In case of an incident

According to CD/ANPD Resolution 15/2024, we will communicate to ANPD and the holders affected in reasonable time, containing: description of the incident, data involved, measures adopted and contacts for additional information.

13. Children and adolescents

The site is not directed to under 18 years of age. We do not intentionally collect data personal of children or adolescents. If we identify such collection, the data will be deleted. Any treatment will respect the best interest and require consent specific to at least one parent or legal guardian (LGPD art. 14; Law 14.708/2023).
